Privacy Policy

How the apps and onlybody.app handle your information, including local workout data, YouTube demonstrations and support enquiries.

1. Who is responsible

This Privacy Policy covers OnlyBody (bodyweight training), OnlyWeights (gym training), and the website at onlybody.app. The apps are developed and operated by Illia Khvost, based in Poland (“I”, “me” or “the developer”). I am the controller for personal information I process to operate this website and respond to you.

Privacy and support contact: support@onlybody.app

Both apps use the same approach to data handling, but keep their data in separate app storage. This policy describes the current versions. It also applies to communications about them before public launch.

2. At a glance

  • No app account or registration is required.
  • Routines, recorded sets and session history are stored on your device. The apps do not upload that database to a developer-operated server or sync it between the two apps.
  • The apps do not include an analytics SDK, a developer advertising SDK, HealthKit integration or social features.
  • Exercise demonstrations use YouTube API Services. Google receives information when the embedded player loads and is used.
  • If you email me, I receive your email address and the information you choose to send.
  • This website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Hosting involves technical request data even though the pages contain no analytics scripts.

3. Information stored on your device

Information Purpose
Workout names, chosen exercises, target muscle groups, scheduled days, planned sets, reps, duration and rest intervals. Build and display your routines and generate sessions from your choices.
Completed session dates, workout names, duration, exercises and recorded reps. Where entered, weights for an exercise or individual sets. Show your training log and exercise history. OnlyWeights is designed around gym training and weight recording.
Timer sound, weight units, reminder settings and local record identifiers. Remember your preferences, link local records and schedule reminders.

The developer does not have remote access to this database. The apps do not request access to contacts, photos, microphone, camera, precise location or Apple Health data. They do not ask for your name, email or date of birth during normal use.

These records can reveal details about your fitness activities. Be careful about including medical information in workout names or sending it in support messages.

4. YouTube demonstrations

Before you press Play: opening an exercise detail screen that includes a demonstration prepares the YouTube player and can send requests to Google immediately. The current apps do not provide a separate switch that prevents this initial connection.

The apps embed the official YouTube player. Requests disclose technical information such as your IP address, browser/device information, app origin, requested video and interactions with the player. Google may process cookies or similar identifiers, show advertisements and process data for its own service, security, measurement and advertising purposes, subject to its policies and your applicable choices.

The embedded browser uses temporary, nonpersistent website storage. This does not prevent network requests, temporary cookies, or Google’s server-side retention. Links opened in your normal browser use that browser’s settings and storage.

The apps do not send your workout database, recorded weights or support emails to YouTube. They do not request Google account authorization, access your subscriptions or retrieve your private YouTube history.

Read the Google Privacy Policy, Google’s cookie information, and YouTube Terms of Service. You can review Google privacy controls and third-party account access; these apps do not currently request that account access.

5. Reminders and Apple services

Workout reminders are optional local notifications scheduled by iOS after you grant notification permission. A developer push server is not used. You can change reminders in the app or disable notifications in iOS Settings.

Your operating system may include app data in device or iCloud backups, depending on your settings. This is separate from app-provided cloud sync. Backup storage, App Store transactions and any diagnostic information handled by Apple are governed by Apple’s settings and Privacy Policy. If Apple makes diagnostic reports available to the developer under your sharing choices, they may be used to investigate reliability problems; the apps do not include a separate crash-reporting SDK.

6. Website visits and support

Website hosting

Cloudflare Pages serves this website. Cloudflare may process IP addresses, requested URLs, request times, browser information and security or delivery logs to provide and protect hosting. The site’s HTML does not include analytics, advertising tags, embedded videos, external fonts, signup forms or scripts that set cookies. Hosting and security infrastructure may still process technical data. See Cloudflare’s Privacy Policy.

Email

If you contact support@onlybody.app, your address, message, email metadata and any attachments are processed to answer the request, troubleshoot a problem or handle a privacy complaint. Email service providers process messages for delivery and storage. Sending a message is optional; please send only information needed for your question, and do not send passwords or unnecessary health details.

I do not use support messages for marketing or sell your personal information. There is no newsletter or mailing-list registration on this site.

7. Purposes, legal bases and recipients

Where GDPR applies to processing for which I am responsible, I rely on the following bases:

  • Requested services — Article 6(1)(b): providing the app functions you request, to the extent the developer is responsible for personal-data processing involved in those functions.
  • Legitimate interests — Article 6(1)(f): delivering and securing this website, answering ordinary support requests, and diagnosing faults. Those interests are keeping the services usable and responding to people who contact me.
  • Legal obligations — Article 6(1)(c): handling applicable data-protection requests and other legally required disclosures or records.

Where consent is legally required for particular third-party storage or processing, it must be obtained separately. Reading or accepting this policy alone is not consent to all cookies or advertising. Google explains its own purposes and legal bases in its privacy policy.

Recipients can include hosting and email service providers, Apple and Google in the circumstances described above, and authorities where disclosure is legally required. I do not give the local workout database to advertisers. Google’s own video and advertising processing is described separately above.

The apps do not make decisions about you that have legal or similarly significant effects. Workout generation uses your selected settings and the exercise catalog; it does not provide a medical assessment.

8. Retention and deletion

  • Local app data: kept on your device until you change or delete it, or remove the app and its data. You can delete saved routines in the app. Deleting a routine does not remove completed training history. The current apps do not provide an individual history-deletion or data-export tool.
  • Removing all local records: use iOS “Delete App” for the relevant app. “Offload App” preserves documents and data. Backups can retain earlier copies; manage those separately through your device or backup provider.
  • Support correspondence: kept while needed to resolve your request and related follow-up, then deleted when it is no longer needed, unless retention is required for a legal obligation or a specific dispute. The nature of the issue, unresolved follow-up and applicable legal requirements determine the period.
  • Third-party records: Apple, Google, Cloudflare and email providers retain information according to their own roles, settings and applicable policies. Removing an app does not automatically erase their records.

You can email me to request deletion of information I hold, such as support correspondence. I cannot remotely retrieve, edit or delete a database stored only on your device.

9. International processing and security

Cloudflare, Google, Apple and email providers may process information in countries outside Poland or the European Economic Area, including the United States. The relevant provider’s policy explains its processing locations and transfer arrangements. Depending on the service and destination, safeguards may include an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses. Contact me for information about transfers involving data I control; this policy is not itself a transfer authorization.

The apps use iOS app storage protections, and web services use HTTPS. Access to support information is limited to handling requests and operating the services. No storage or transmission method guarantees absolute security. Protect access to your device and any backups you make.

10. Your choices and rights

Depending on applicable law and the circumstances, you may request access to, correction or erasure of personal information I hold, restriction of processing, or a portable copy. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Contact support@onlybody.app. I may ask for proportionate information to verify a request. GDPR requests are normally answered within one month, with any permitted extension explained. Rights have legal conditions and exceptions; I will explain if I cannot fulfil a request.

You can complain to a supervisory authority, including the Polish Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), or the authority in your country of habitual residence, work or the alleged infringement.

For information held independently by Google, Apple or another provider, use that provider’s privacy tools or contact process. The developer’s inability to access local workout records does not require you to upload them to make a privacy enquiry.

11. Children

The apps and website are general fitness tools and are not designed or marketed specifically to children. They do not collect dates of birth or create child accounts. A minor should use them with appropriate parent or guardian involvement and meet any applicable age requirements of third-party services. If you believe a child has sent personal information directly to me, contact me so I can review and, where appropriate, delete it.

12. Changes and contact

I will update this policy when the services or relevant data practices change and revise the date shown above. Material changes will be brought to your attention through an appropriate notice; any legally required consent will be requested separately.

Questions about either app or this website: support@onlybody.app.
